title: Cryopreservation of C. elegans with DMSO and Trehalose
author: Oscar Carrillo
materials: 3er lavado con 4 ml de Buffer TDMSO.

steps.title: First wash with M9 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL sterile M9 buffer at room temperature to the worm pellet and transfer the suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Second wash with M9 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL sterile M9 buffer at room temperature to the pellet and transfer the suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge worm suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 2000 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend in TDMSO
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 4 mL TDMSO (trehalose‑DMSO solution) and proceed to the next step within 15 minutes to maintain viability.

steps.title: Cool cryovials before freezing
steps.instruction: Place the cryovials in a polystyrene box and incubate at –1 °C for 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Assess viability and store samples
steps.instruction: After 1 week, test worm viability; if viable, store two tubes at –80 °C and one tube in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Thaw and recover worms
steps.instruction: To thaw, warm the entire tube, then pour the contents onto an NGM plate; alternatively, keep the tube on its side or upside‑down to allow scraping and partial revival.
